bitfield.description: Hide assets. 0. OPEN 1. HIDE This bit is the status of ROM hide H/W indication. 1 - ROM Assets (2KB in M3 BOOT ROM is hidden); 0 - ROM Assets (2KB in M3 BOOT ROM) is NOT hidden. NOTE: same as [ROMASSETS]

UDS Read Enable. 0 - HIDE 1- OPEN This bit is the status of UDS hide H/W indication. 1 - UDS is readable; 0 - UDS is hidden. The Status Registers [UDS0.*], [UDS1.*], [UDS2.*], [UDS3.*] and [FUSELINE3.*], [FUSELINE4.*], [FUSELINE5.*], [FUSELINE6.*] will be read as 0

Device At test. 0 - FALSE 1 - TRUE This bit indicates the Device is in ATTEST (or First Birthday). Specifically, the Fuse pass without EFC or CRC errors, the Lifecycle is either 0 or 1 and strong pattern is all zeros. NOTE: same as [SECBYPASS]

Security Bypass. 0 - FALSE 1 - TRUE This bit indicates the Device is in ATTEST (or First Birthday). Specifically, the Fuse pass without EFC or CRC errors, the Lifecycle is either 0 or 1 and strong pattern is all zeros. NOTE: same as [DEVATTEST]

PRCM SOP: 0- DEBUG 1- DEFAULT 2- FSPKG 3- FSPRB This field reflects the Device Sense on Power (SOP): OSPREY_DEV_SOP_SOC_DEBUG 2'h0 OSPREY_DEV_SOP_DEFAULT 2'h1 OSPREY_DEV_SOP_FORCE_SUPPLY_PKG 2'h2 OSPREY_DEV_SOP_FORCE_SUPPLY 2'h3
EFC Error. This field reflects the Device fuse shift EFC error 5 bits. All zeros means no error.
EFC Autoload Done. 0 - FAIL 1 - PASS This bit indicates the Device h/w fuse shit progress has been done.

Device LifeCycle Valid. 0 - FAIL 1 - PASS This bit indicates the Device h/w fuse shift has pass without EFC or CRC errors and that the Lifecycle matches the strong pattern. Meaning pattern equal to 0 in LC equal to 0 or 1; pattern equal to LC of ATTST PRIVILEGE; pattern equal to LC of Operational;

Core Enable, 0 - NO 1 - YES This bit indicates the Device Application CPU requested the Network CPU to power off ("Connectivity Stop" a.k.a "SL STOP" in former device family). When This bit is set the Network Core CPU registers will be automatically cleared. The device is now ready to be reloaded in "elevated mode" namely Secondary Boot.

Pattern Match LyfeCycle. 0 - NO_MATCH 1 - MATCH This bit indicates the Device h/w fuse shift has done and that the Lifecycle matches the strong pattern. Meaning pattern equal to 0 in LC equal to 0 or 1; pattern equal to LC of ATTST PRIVILEGE; pattern equal to LC of Operational; NOTE: No validity Check is conditioning this indication. Specifically no EFC or CRC check masks this indication.
Fuse CRC Check Passed. 0 - NO 1- YES This bit indicates the Device h/w fuse shift has passed without CRC error, or that fuse shift is done with the CRC check being ignored by System PRCM module
PRCM Ignore Fuse CRC Check. 0 - NO 1 - YES This bit indicates the Device System PRCM module sets the CRC check ignored bit
HW CRC Enable. This field reflects the Device fuse shift field HWCRCEN (3b) in case that EFC check has passed. Otherwise, it reflects "000"
Device LifeCycle Strong Pattern Valid. 0 - FAIL 1- PASS This bit indicates the fuse shift is done without EFC error
Hide Boot ROM. This bit is the status of ROM hide H/W indication. 1 - entire Boot ROM is hidden; 0 - Boot ROM is NOT hidden.

Hide Rom Assets, 0 - OPEN 1- HIDE This bit is the status of ROM hide H/W indication. 1 - ROM Assets (2KB in M3 BOOT ROM is hidden); 0 - ROM Assets (2KB in M3 BOOT ROM) is NOT hidden. NOTE: same as [HIDEASSETS]
Device Elevated Mode.
